releases.displayName: UPDATE: Sell your horses! Or look for magic...

items.text: You probably didn't expect anything, but we're like the Rustler's Inquisition - you may never know when and where to expect us. So here we are. With another update for Rustler.
From now on...

All you have to do is steal a horse from any NPC or pick up one on the parking lots in the game's world and go to the stable next to the Pokehorse Man is This Neigh Land. Each type of horse has its value, so be sure to see which one turns out to be the most valuable of them all.
Remember to not sell them during quests - selling horses is available only when you don't have an active quest on you.

notes.title: Yet Another Fantasy Title arrives on April 10th!

items.text: Rustler's spin-off in a fantasy setting premieres in a couple of days! You will be able to ride horses and various magical creatures, and cast many different spells! All with a solid dose of pop-culture references and humor!

notes.title: Add YAFT to your wishlist right now and don't miss its launch!

items.text: May the horse be with you, Rustlers!
Rustler team

releases.displayName: July Update: we hear you and we deliver

items.text: It seems that Guy spilled the tea somewhere lately because we have received a lot of questions about further updates. Well, be careful what you wish for... or rather be happy that you get what you wish for because we have a little something for you.

However, before we introduce you to the July update, we want to thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your continuous support and hundreds of hours of conversations when you've shared your feedback with us. We're thankful for each review because without them - both positive and negative - we wouldn't know which features need improvement. And even though we're not able to change many things at this stage of Rustler's development, we can promise you that we will take this experience with us and use it in the development of our other games.
So once again - thank you! Rustler wouldn't exist if it weren't for you and your participation in different surveys.

Yes, you see that right, in April Rustler has been marked as Steam Deck Verified. Since then many of you have played it there and thanks to your engagement, we were able to optimize Rustler for Steam Deck a bit more. Thank you! Enjoy Guy's adventures on the newest Valve's gaming hardware and let us know your opinion!
[expand type=details]
The list contains only the most often reported bugs, we've fixed many minor ones as well:
We've added some extra time to the mace murderfest so it would be a bit easier to complete.
If you quit the game right after watching the intro and then load the save, you should be able to continue the game without any problems.
The Taxi Guy fail report won't show up on the game's screen while playing other minigames.
If you've killed Sleazy in your previous gameplay, don't worry, you'll meet him again on the next run.
Winning MMA fights will no longer block you from launching minigames with the "E" key while sitting on a horse's back.
You shouldn't experience any problems with the "condemned" scenes anymore.
If you try to repeat the "His Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy" quest while doing the "Take Sleazy Home" quest, Sleazy should now show up in the return point anyway and follow Guy.
In the side quest "By a Long Shot", Guy shouldn't be seen floating anymore.
You're not able to buy a safe house while riding on a taxi horse.
If the 3rd debtor hits Guy while he's sitting on a horse, Guy shouldn't get blocked from performing other actions.
Exploding red barrels and TNT will kill you without locking you in place. No chance of surviving the hit or getting stuck now.
Guy shouldn't have the chance to spin around in place now after jumping off the med cart.
We've tried to fix all language issues. Let us know if we've taken proper care of that.
You won't fail the Stayin' Alive minigame by hitting a passer-by anymore.

If you have both: psycho fan and mercenary following you on the map, you don't have to worry anymore that they will keep throwing each other off the horse. The psycho fan will keep following you even if the place on the horse's back is taken.

If you buy the bard's services and then fire him, and hire him once again, the bard won't throw a tantrum anymore - earlier, he had some trouble with his pride and didn't want to sing after being rehired. And you know, we've had "a talk" and now he'll be singing more beautifully than ever, whenever you decide to give him a job :)
Any quest markers on the map will now point in the one and only right direction. Thanks to them, you will be able to, f.ex., localize stakes in the quarry sooner.
[expand type=details]
We've improved the game's performance on Steam Deck.
The problem with two Guys showing up at once on your screen has been solved. You won't see a duplicated Guy again. At least not in our game.
Remember that both Rustler DLCs: Murder Madness and Vinci await you! We've also prepared a special art book, as well as the soundtrack that you enjoy so much in the game!
And if you want to get a full package, you can do that by buying a bundle!

notes.title: Hop on a unicorn and check Yet Another Fantasy Title!

items.text: If you like Rustler, hop on your unicorn and ride straight into Yet Another Fantasy Title.

Become a rogue in an open-world fantasy action RPG and slay the dragon. Drink with ogres, steal the Ring from nasty goblins and bring mayhem to all and everyone around. Win a hand of a kingdom and a half of a princess... Wait, is there even any princess in this story?

notes.title: Add to the wishlist to find this and many more out

items.text: Watch the trailer here.

And at the end of this announcement, let us use this moment to wish you a wonderful, colorful, and relaxing summertime! Rustler team hopes that you will enjoy these couple of months as much as possible.

notes.title: May the horse be with you,

items.text: Team Rustler

releases.displayName: April Update: a new encounter and fixes

items.text: When the last announcement appeared here just three weeks ago, welcoming spring and Easter event, we haven't expected to get pranked on April Fools so easily. Mother Nature had her plans, though, and decided to let it snow. In April, you see it right.
However, we wanted to let you know we're happy that you enjoy the in-game Easter event and our little April Fools' Day surprise! We've decided to bring you one more patch before Easter, though!

notes.title: We've come bearing gifts... and fixes

items.text: The last update brought you new encounters that make the game's world feel more alive. Horse kicking random NPCs, cows falling from the sky, a psycho fan following Guy around, and many more. This time, we have NPCs randomly jumping on Taxi horse's back and taking a quick ride into the unknown. At least, it will remain unknown until you decide to chase them and check where they decide to get off.

notes.title: Here come some fixes as well

items.text: Since the March update, you've reported some new and recurring bugs. We've made sure that this time all the most critical bugs are fixed and the game's balance is improved. We've also added some new checkpoints.

notes.title: If you want to know more, you can find details below

items.text: We've added new checkpoints in the quests: High Season, The Great Battle of Registration, and Meat Muffins.
Jousting and horse racing should be now working properly.
Easter event has an easier-to-fulfill condition of completion. You don't have to collect all the eggs on the map anymore to complete the event.
Controllers' bug is fixed and using gamepads shouldn't cause you troubles anymore.
MMA progress is counted correctly now. Due to that, the game's progress should be counted correctly.
NPCs won't steal the horse that Guy has just rode.
Bishop's guards will now properly react if you try to shoot them from a distance.
Guy shouldn't get stuck next to the tombstone anymore.
There shouldn't be any places left with a visible connection of textures.
Enemies' shields should be well visible now.
You should not be losing Guy's outfit that we wore when saving the game after loading this save.
If you haven't heard about Rustler DLCs - Murder Madness and Vinci - yet, then go on and grab them for just 4,99 now!
And if you want to get a full package, you can do that by buying a bundle with a soundtrack: Rustler: Complete Edition with a 10% discount.
If you haven't heard about Infection Free Zone yet, you must check it out now. You've dealt with guards and crooks as Guy in Rustler. Now it's time to fight the Infected... and survive.

Take charge of a group of survivors from your city. Choose your base of operations, then rebuild and readapt the buildings around you to create a self-sustaining settlement. And when the night falls - Defend the zone from the infected! Play on ANY CITY IN THE WORLD, using real geographical data!

notes.title: May the horse be with you,

items.text: Team Rustler

releases.displayName: Easter event, new encounters, Steam Deck and more - MAJOR UPDATE!

items.text: Easter is coming, so we have some easter eggs for you. Like literally. However, that's just a tiny bit of what we have prepared for you.
In April (starting April 1, 2022), you will be able to enjoy the Easter event focused on - you have no idea, right? - collecting Easter eggs in Rustler's world. An egg-cellent idea, isn't it?
Many of you wanted a more lively world. There you have it! We've prepared some new encounters for you to enjoy in the game, including:
Random NPC will try to steal other NPC's horses (doesn't apply to Guy, though, 'cause they know he's badass).
It's raining cows! Yes, you can encounter a cow falling straight on some NPCs' heads now!
Keep an eye on your cows! And on those not yours too. Because... UFO is coming to make their world amooooosing.

You can now meet your no. 1 fan! Or well, more like a psycho fan. He will follow you around and cheer for you when you fight! A pity they didn't have a camera in middle-ages, right? He could be a paparazzi!
Spanish Inquisition will be even more unexpected than ever. Play Rustler a couple of times and discover all of the locations where inquisitors can catch up with you!
You can encounter certain groups of NPCs fighting each other. However, mind that if you decide to join in on the fun, the only person happy about it will (probably) be Guy.
Some parked horses know what boredom is... and may kick random NPCs who are walking behind them!

notes.title: Vinci + Madness = DLCs awaiting your attention

items.text: Remember that both Rustler DLCs: Murder Madness and Vinci await you! Experience new adventures with Guy and get access to new weapons, horses, rides, and functionalities.
Today we have something special to share with you. A never before published video of a dark tank (prepared for DLC Vinci) with the Knight Rider theme!
Enjoy this totally unexpected turn of events and come with us into the future... or more like the past. Medieval ages kind of past. No matter who it may take us up against or where.
[expand type=details]
You shouldn't have any problems with horse despawning after finishing certain quests.
Problems with MMA progress and due to that with the whole game progress % count have been fixed. One fight was missing.
Buddy's HP is increased so he wouldn't die that easily. At last, what friends are for in this cruel world, right?
You shouldn't have any problems with throwing a holy grenade now.
The game shouldn't crash during longer chases.
There should be 5 Murder Fests available in the base game.
If a horse stands between you and Vin during dialogue before the first Vin's quest, there should not be any problems with Guy's pathfinding anymore.
You can't use an auto crossbow in MMA anymore.
You can't enter any of the houses in the first village.
Death costume won't be available to use at any point of the game without finishing
Pokehorse side-quest gives the correct horse as a reward now.
Killing the courier after getting the objective to go to the cemetery won't be considered a failure anymore.
Tables placed in Vinci's workshop should have proper colliders now.
Any z-fighting issues were fixed.
There shouldn't be any sharp texture seams visible.
Any misspelling issues should be fixed.
If you're a lucky owner of the Steam Deck, you can now play Rustler without any problems, major bugs, and crashes. Have fun with Valve's newest invention, and let us know about your experience!

notes.title: May the horse be with you, Rustlers!

items.text: Team Rustler

releases.displayName: January update: let's start this year with a kick!

items.text: We're happy to welcome you into 2022! Due to this occasion, we have some bug fixes for you. And when I say "some", I mean quite a lot! You've provided us with a lot of priceless feedback since the last update. Thank you for supporting us all the way! It means a lot to us that you want to take your time and share your thoughts on the game with us.

notes.title: Here's a list of fixes that you'll find in today's update

items.text: [expand type=details]
The automatic crossbow should work properly now :)
Quest A Hero This City Deserves should be easier to complete now due to correcting information about the wanted level and Capitain Middle Age's behavior.
Guy shouldn't be able to leave the playable area.
You shouldn't be able to get on high stones on a horse now. Many object colliders were fixed.
You cannot get blocked behind the stables in the second city's Army Camp.
Water shouldn't disappear from the sea anymore.
Texts in quest Witch, please should be set in the correct order.
Guy won't be able to shoot Vinci's assistant with arquebus, before getting an objective.
After getting into the tank, Guy shouldn't be seen running next to it.
There shouldn't be any more problems with audio disappearing after mounting a horse.
The Taxi mini-game was updated, and now you won't fail it due to knocking NPC down or getting chased by guards.
During dialogue with Vin Guy cannot run around anymore.
Minor changes of names used do describe specific game settings.
There is an improved Japanese translation.
There are also minor fixes to other translations that you've reported recently.
You should be able to get a rematch at MMA. The activation circle should also work well.
If you run the barrels over with your horse in the Science, peach quests, you will now fail the quest (there was a problem with progress blocking because of destroying barrels this way).
You won't have trouble with losing the arquebus after failing the MurderFest with an arquebus as a mandatory weapon.
Remember that both Rustler DLCs: Murder Madness and Vinci await you! And if you want to get a full package, you can do that by buying a bundle!

notes.title: May the horse be with you

items.text: Team Rustler

We're coming to you with a minor update (and lots of snow in Warsaw!). We have added some visual improvements and minor fixes. As always, your feedback plays a great role there. Thank you for supporting Rustler and sending your notes and suggestions via private message, Discord, Steam discussion, or the in-game bug reporter! We're pleased to have such a dedicated community.

Doesn't it seem like a perfect Christmas gift? Especially that there's a Santa event going on! You can deliver gifts to the nicer fellas... or attack the bad ones who dare to impersonate Santa! With snowballs, of course!
Treat yourself with two great DLCs! Hire mercenaries, bring chaos to the medieval folks with a Flamethrower, ride a Chariot and help Vinci with his inventions!

Taunting is in da house! If you have a sword and a shield, you can taunt and provoke your enemies by hitting your own shield with your sword. [Tip: When Guy uses a sword with a shield, press RMB + Tab to taunt during the fight.]
Tank's image will change according to how damaged it is.
You can see the damage done to the tank more clearly now thanks to the smoke and splinters coming from it after each hit. You can also hear a "boom" when it breaks down.

notes.title: And here are some minor bugfixes

items.text: [expand type=details]
You can't push the priest into the church anymore in the A-men side quest.
Mercenaries shouldn't disappear from the map anymore.
Fixed a bug when the player is given a screen where it is monotone and a tutorial prompt is shown, if the player returns back to the main menu and selects a new game, the game will play very slowly.

notes.title: May the horse be with you,

items.text: Rustler team
Just a moment before Vinci DLC launch, we have a little update for you!

notes.title: Take a look at some of the bug fixes

items.text: [expand type=details]
Guy can no longer get on the top of the roof in the French camp.
Guy can no longer ride a horse cart on top of the buildings or different objects.
Pony Express shouldn't launch during Medieval Martial Arts.
Improved animation of Guy aiming the crossbow to the back while riding on a horse.
Get ready for the Vinci DLC release this Wednesday! We can't wait to share some new challenges for Guy with you :)
We have something special prepared for you to celebrate Christmas together! Keep an eye on the upcoming announcements... or try to guess what we've come up with :) The comment section is yours!
Best regards,
Rustler team

releases.displayName: MAJOR UPDATE - MurderFests and much more!

items.text: Hello Rustlers,

It's been over four weeks since Rustler's official launch and coming out of Early Access. We've been working hard all this time to fix bugs and issues that you've reported. Thank you once again for your help and for taking the time to leave your feedback.
But that's not all! We've also added some new stuff to the base game and fixed a couple of issues.
There is a new mini-game called MurderFest, available in various parts of the game's world. Find them all!
The pitchfork is now available as a new weapon. Many peasants use them too!
Special horses needed to complete one of the side quests are now a bit easier to find!
The time of the day will change from day to night, and from night to day every time you use a save house.

If your save file got corrupted somehow, and it's not possible to recover it, you will see short information about it before the game launches. This mechanic also helps if you couldn't see any of the existing save files on the list.
During specific mini-games, the stamina level will reset after each stage of the mini-game.
[expand type=details]
The Crown achievement should work correctly now! A lot of you have asked about it and we’ve finally found the reason for its failure and fixed it!
Fixed bug where a player couldn't continue the mission "Witch, please" after destroying the cart.
Fixed a piece of dialogue flow in the "By a Long Shot" quest.
In the "A Very, Very Big Cow" quest prisoner's pickaxe won't disappear anymore.
Fixed bug in "By a Long Shot" quest where a player couldn't put the Round-Earther's body on the cart.
The lute doesn't become stuck to the chest anymore and is held in the correct position when swapping weapon modes.
Fixed a bug where the lute couldn't be used as a weapon.
In the "High Stakes" quest you won't be able to continue the cutscene if one of the Inquisition members dies.
Aiming animation won't switch between front and back repeatedly while aiming the Crossbow/Auto Crossbow backward when a player is on a horse.
Fixed bug where the list of saved games didn't follow the selection when player toggles slots using a gamepad.
Fixed bug in which skipping dialogue caused the nearby bard to get hired or fired.
You can't force the priest to attend the mass in Church Herding activity anymore.
Fixed bug in which hiring bard during Church Herding mini-game caused the disappearance of quest name and people counter.
Horses should spawn normally after finishing the This Neigh Land side-quest.
A player won't get locked in a blocking stance with a shield anymore.
After destroying the cart with a witch and reloading the checkpoint because of failing the quest, the destroyed cart won't appear on the checkpoint mark.

During the task 'Defend the forger's house for one minute. Don't leave the area' in 'A Brave New World' quest when the player mounts on a horse and takes a U-turn within the confined area, it is no longer observed that the title perceives the player is out of bounds.
The black screen won't appear after a successfully completed quest with the knights of the Holy Grail.
Fixed money exploit from save houses.
You won't get stuck in the MMA Arena after dying.
Salazar won't be attacking dead sailors anymore (we know, he wants to be gangsta TOO badly).
Crossbow NPCs will no longer remain idle in MMA Arena on the 2nd island after Guy moves closer to attack them with fists.
Pressing the right mouse button won't hide the weapon sight.
Dead bodies for the Body Collecting activity will no longer spawn in unavailable places.
Fixed the bug where the collision failed to change when the player proceeded to any horse cart and killed the horse.
All of the Kickstarter backers are present in the game.
Guy should no longer get stuck after collecting a horseshoe.
Guy shouldn't become invisible anymore.
The Taxi Guy activity should work properly - fixed bug where the timer continued counting for a couple of seconds more after NPC walked on the quest mark.
Dead horses shouldn't move around the map any longer.
Horses shouldn't tremble anymore.
Water should be visible in the game.
All untranslated lines should be translated now.
You can't buy armor when you're in the Death's costume.
Guy won't get stuck under any roofs anymore.
another Jutsu Games team (the guys from the 911 / 112 Operators) is working on another title, a city survival, re-builder game with REAL MAPS! Check it out, as they just launched a Kickstarter!
Sincerely,
Team Rustler

releases.displayName: MINOR FIX is available for download now

items.text: Dear Rustlers!
First of all, we apologize for any and all issues you might encounter while playing our new game. We do our best to fix them as soon as possible.

Almost three days have passed since Rustler left Early Access. We are grateful for your feedback, it's the best source of motivation for us. All the bug reports you Guys are sending are greatly appreciated!

notes.title: Here's a list of hotfixes, first of many to come

items.text: Additional horses will no longer spawn when you kill Buddy at the start of the "High Season" quest and load a checkpoint.
Barrels stored under the wooden roof in Holy Grail Knights' distillery will no longer drop loot
The name "Roach" in German is now correct.
Dead NPC will no longer talk if killed before interaction during the "By a Long Shot" quest.
Dead NPC will no longer talk when you kill them during the task 'Catch the thug' of the "Drug Problem" quest.
The game will now autosave after each round of MMA.
Lil' Sleazy and the red Horspeed will not longer get cloned if you lose the race and load a checkpoint in the "Great Boots of Fire" quest.
Fixed an exploit where it was possible to heal Guy if the player would reset and reassign the Reguyneration skill in gameplay.
Fixed Lil' Sleazy's dialogue during the race in the "Great Boots of Fire" quest.
Fixed an issue where players could immediately control Guy during the final dialogue in the "Great Boots of Fire" quest.
SPOILER: Fixed the last fight in the "All Eyes on Me" quest where Herb appeared twice in a cutscene.
SPOILER: NPCs will no longer leave if Guy loses to Herb in the "All Eyes on Me" quest.
Please, review Rustler on Steam if you enjoy it! Your feedback is invaluable to us!
May the horse be with you!
Team Rustler 🐴
Are you craving for some new stuff? We are updating the game to version 0.16.02!
Here we are, with a lot of good things going on. Check it out below:
Added mid-quest checkpoints;
Added purchasable save points in the form of real estate scattered around the map;
Added loading screen tips to give you some interesting info;
Added changeable clothes as an in-game item. Some of those clothes give you some bonuses;
Improved horse steering (like a lot). Horses will try to avoid hitting obstacles if possible;
Increased game FPS, drastically (thanks console porting team!);
Some quests give more cash now to help you reach the goal easier;
Improved game stability;
Improved game balance;
Improved translations;
Happy Rustling ;)

items.text: Your game should now update to v0.15.04 – make sure this number matches the one in the bottom right of your menu screen. Check out what’s new:
Displaying map now pauses the game.
Guy does not lose all momentum after a roll
Horse HP increased
Spear guards antihorse bonus decreased
Number of guards lowered for normal and easy mode
Further balancing of the guard spawning system dependant to the difficulty level
Bleeding skill and fire effect won’t do final hit to prevent some quest from failing
Bard’s quest now causes wanted level 1 instead of 2
Vsync now works as intended
Horses should never be immortal now

(loads of other minor stuff and bugs): The roadmap of further changes is still under preparation, but we can already assure you that the checkpoints will be added by the end of this month 😊: Stay tuned for future updates!
Dear Players!

Thank you all for playing and sharing your opinions. We are monitoring your feedback carefully. After a weekend hard at work, we have just published a huge update with major AI changes. This should make your experience way more enjoyable.
AI opponents will now lower their guard from time to time.
AI opponents will now be less eager to retaliate immediately after blocking an attack.
The guards will now make fewer attempts to jail the player when mounted on a horse.
The number of attacks performed by mounted guards has been lowered.
At the same time, we tried to improve the experience on hard mode without changing too much at the core!
The first two quests have had their difficulty lowered significantly (i.e. fewer guard spawns).
During quests, using F9 will now reload the game from their starting point (while, by the way, fixing all the quest-related issues that may occur).
The first few fights in the MMA Side Activity have been rebalanced for a more challenging experience.
Several other bug fixes.

notes.title: This week the team will focus mainly on

items.text: Adding extra checkpoints to quests, so you do not have to restart them from the very beginning.
Further game balancing (various skill/perk combinations in particular).
Minor and major bugfixes.
Known issues that are yet to be fixed (sorry about that)
MMA fight with 2 monks might be super hard to pass
pressing E after MMA fights might restart the fights until you start another quest.
The controls might glitch when certain controllers are plugged in (a steering wheel and/or pedals); we recommend unplugging them before playing Rustler.

Reloading an autosave made after quest completion (Jousting one in particular) might spawn you in inaccessible locations. Do not trust them entirely - better rely on savepoints and quest start autosave: Should you encounter any other bugs (which we hope you won’t), please use the internal bug reporting tool from the ESC menu or write to us on the Steam Discussions forum. We are paying remarkably close attention to every case!: Happy horse stealing!
